correctness.rationale: The stable causal filter is integrable; its nonnegative, strictly positive on positive times impulse response in the overdamped and critically damped cases proves strict positivity by the double convolution. In the underdamped case put f=a0/m and D=(beta+k)^2+omega^2. Stationary balance gives E[V sigma]=k E[X sigma], D E[X sigma]=f, E[XV]=0 and 2 beta E[V^2]=f E[V sigma]. The V-X balance then gives the stated C(0), and conditioning on the future orientation gives the forced covariance ODE with C'(0)=0. Solving and dividing by A yields the displayed cosine and sine coefficients. At k=beta the ratio R/A is strictly below 1 for every omega>0. For q=k/beta<1 and x=(omega/beta)^2, the squared amplitude minus 1 has numerator F_q(x) over 4x(1+x) after cancellation; F_q decreases on x>0 and is negative at (1-q^2)/3. This covers the nonnegative sine coefficient. For the other case, b,h_*<0 and 0<-b<1, 0<-h_*<a; comparison on the first quadrant follows from the nonpositive derivative of exp(-a theta)(cos theta+a sin theta), on the second from a<exp(a theta) for theta>=pi/2, and the other two quadrants give strict bounds immediately. Periodicity proves the comparison for all lags. For k>beta, late cosine peaks and troughs give opposite signs. The first zero and the onset of negative values are bounded below by log(A/R)/(k-beta) near the threshold and above by that time plus one period. A trough exactly at the bound has negative derivative, so the upper bound also covers negativity. Smoothness of R/A at k=beta gives the claimed coefficient and O(1) remainder for either definition. Do not identify first zero and first sign-changing zero exactly: a negative-cosine lobe can touch zero at its strict interior minimum (at phase pi+arctan((k-beta)/omega) modulo 2pi), and then the earlier zero is tangential. This does not affect either asymptotic. The signed area follows by integrating the double convolution over the full line, using int h=Omega^(-2) and int exp(-k|t|)=2/k, then halving by evenness. The original checker was inspected, not run. Independent bounded replay /workspace/replay/1_delay.py recovered the example 23.69746138449596 and illustrates the possible tangency; finite examples are not the threshold proof.
